---
title: "dae"
subtitle: "Functions Useful in the Design and ANOVA of Experiments"
---

Covers data, factor manipulation, design, ANOVA, matrix, projector and canonical efficiency functions. The design functions randomise and assess designs. The ANOVA functions extract information from `aov` fits that use `Error()`.

**Author:** Chris Brien

```r
install.packages("dae")
```
